disposition_reason: MINT contains original ordered synthetic-estimator and held-out population-decoder comparisons, so the paper is not categorically ineligible. The current CA1 direct-information reference is descriptive calibration only. The exact original improvement branch, numeric author baseline, binning and fold correspondence must be recovered before admission; larger empirical direct MI or stronger significance cannot substitute for that recovery.

source_paper.title: MINT: A toolbox for the analysis of multivariate neural information coding and transmission

evidence.locator: Design and implementation; Results: Computing the role of interactions between neurons in information encoding; Figure 2C caption; Data availability and S1 Data
evidence.supports: Identifies direct pair information, information decompositions and separate population-decoder information; CA1 has 11 sessions, 43–104 neurons and 36,158 simultaneous pairs; S1 Data is the empirical source.

evidence.locator: Options lines 1–25; pair loop lines 33–64; population decoder lines 66–123
evidence.supports: Uses Position and R_neuron_binned, fixed labels, response cap 4 and 30 shuffle corrections; the direct MI call is commented out. Population SVM folds are a separate computation, not a truth target for direct MI.
Author implementation route for mutual information and bias correction; source availability does not establish true information in empirical CA1 data.

evidence.locator: Computational contract; Primary source reconciliation; Validation and remaining work
evidence.supports: Local implementation computes fixed-bin MI, QE and null diagnostics and explicitly disclaims native equivalence, empirical reproduction and inferential calibration.

target.description: Select and recover an original source performance branch: information recovered by a population decoder from held-out CA1 responses (Figure 2C), or estimator accuracy against source-defined known truth in the original simulations. Do not optimize the descriptive direct-pair MI value. These source branches remain distinct and no scalar mixture or new endpoint is selected here.

dataset.description: Original Figure 2C CA1 calcium recordings are supplied as S1 Data, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1012934.s002. Source Figure 2A/B separately uses simulated 20-neuron responses to two stimuli under defined correlation structures. The selected performance branch and complete source-version/generator binding are unresolved; no replacement dataset is introduced.

cohort.description: Figure 2C has 11 recording sessions with 43–104 neurons and 36,158 pairs. Figure 2A/B instead concerns source simulations of 20 neurons responding to two stimuli, with simulation repeats. Exact animal/session identity or simulation-case selection must follow the eventual original performance branch; neuron pairs are not independent animals.

split.description: Original Figure 2C population decoding reports five trial folds, while the pinned CA1 figure wrapper specifies twofold SVM and optimization options. Resolve this discrepancy and recover exact trial partitions before a same-task comparison. Direct MI uses empirical observations without a supervised split; those descriptive outputs cannot stand in for held-out decoder performance.

inputs.description: For the original decoder branch use the same CA1 neural responses and spatial-position labels with source training/test access. Synthetic estimator comparisons must retain the exact author generator, stimulus/response distributions and sample counts, exposing only source-allowed sampled observations to the estimator. Protected evaluation truths are not estimator inputs.

preprocessing.description: Freeze original calcium discretization, spatial bins and observation ordering. The inspected source disables rebinning, caps response labels at four and uses shuffSub with 30 shuffles; the local record documents unresolved binning/source-schema correspondence.

metric.description: The source population branch computes information in the held-out SVM confusion matrix, I(S;S_hat) in bits; this lower bound is distinct from direct empirical pair MI. A source simulation accuracy branch needs its original known-truth target and error definition. Recover a single branch-specific ordered metric and numeric author comparator rather than treating larger direct MI as accuracy.

aggregation.description: Figure 2C population information is summarized across 11 sessions and five trial folds, separately from 36,158 pairwise direct-information estimates; source simulations have their own repetition/fold reductions. Exact per-fold outputs and selected branch aggregate are not recovered. No pair/fold count is promoted to independent-animal uncertainty.

comparison.primary_metric: Original source held-out population-decoder information or known-truth estimator error; branch and exact baseline unresolved

published_baseline.description: The paper presents original SVM population-information and simulated estimator comparisons, but an exact numeric author performance value with selected branch/fold/generator provenance is not recovered. CA1 direct MI estimates remain descriptive, not scores to maximize.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No source-matched population-decoder or original known-truth performance rerun is established. The local fixed-bin MI/QE/null code is an independent calibration reference; the author direct-MI call is commented out and the population-fold choices differ from the paper.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful gain must be justified for the selected original held-out decoder information or estimator-error target after recovery of source score variability. No margin can be assigned to raising an unknown empirical direct-MI estimate.

uncertainty.method: After branch recovery, predeclare paired candidate/author contrasts on identical source folds or independent original simulation draws, with session/animal clustering and original temporal dependence preserved. No confidence threshold is yet admitted.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological animal/session clusters for CA1; genuinely independent source simulation repetitions for simulation claims. Overlapping neuron pairs, folds, sampled time points and shuffles are not automatically independent.
uncertainty.rationale: Source descriptive pair/fold summaries do not resolve valid superiority uncertainty. Synthetic known truth and empirical information lower bounds answer separate questions.

paper_win_requires: Recover and freeze an original paper performance branch, its complete source data/generator, preprocessing, split, ordered metric, reduction and numeric author baseline.

For Figure 2C decoding, retain the original spatial-decoding task and neural population, resolve paper fivefold versus wrapper twofold options, and compare held-out confusion-matrix information on identical folds.
For a source simulation estimator branch, retain its exact original distributions, sample sizes and known-truth target; new simulation families are extensions, not source-paper wins.
Require meaningful gain and valid uncertainty against the reproduced author performance; do not replace it with the local direct-MI/QE/null reference.
Larger direct empirical MI, stronger p-values, lower variance or reconstruction agreement alone cannot establish a paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA claim; surpassing this source paper and surpassing later methods are separate source-verified comparisons.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive pending selection and recovery of the original source performance branch. Thereafter allow training/validation feedback for the source decoder or estimator while keeping CA1 descriptive MI and null reconstruction separate.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze branch identity, method, binning, source folds/generator, tuning rule and complete evaluation denominator before final held-out labels or simulation truths are opened.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate candidate and reproduced author method on identical original held-out decoder folds or original known-truth simulation cases, reporting the selected source metric and uncertainty. Keep all direct-MI reconstruction outputs calibration-only.
episode.baseline_policy: Native MINT source performance must be separately reconstructed for the selected original branch; local independent direct-MI values and repaired source calls cannot supply a paper-win baseline.

blocking_issues: Original source performance branch and exact numeric author baseline not frozen or recovered.
Paper Figure 2C fivefold population decoding conflicts with pinned source twofold settings; original trial identities and optimization recipe unresolved.
Original binning, CA1 payload identity and complete animal/session mapping remain unresolved; simulation branch would instead require original generator and known-truth/error correspondence.
Local implementation covers descriptive direct MI/QE/null diagnostics, not a qualified source-native performance comparator.
Task-specific meaningful effect, valid uncertainty, concrete budgets and a working source-matched evaluator remain unqualified.

legacy.notes: Retain MI/QE/null estimator, MAT preparation, source discrepancies and historical reproduction materials. Their numerical and shuffle checks are not a paper-win evaluator.
